name: Jessenia
source:
Little and less historical material exists chronicling the supernatural creature known simply as "Jessena". What is known is that she is ancient, very beatiful, as well as very, very undead. Over the Nine Seas she has earned the infamos moniker "The Dread Pirate Queen". Her carrack, the "Black Pearl Necklace", terrorizes seafaring commerce between dusk and dawn. Striking like lightning and vanishing as quickly as it appears, the crew of the Black Pearl Necklace have a knack for absconding with copious amounts of booty, both human and material alike.

[From [url=/v21056]Dead Tide - Director's Cut[/url], in-game character profile]
